items.title: Joseph Thomas Interview, 1960-09-29
items.q: So Kid René got me to play with him.

ctx.x: Then I played with Kid René years ago. I played with John Lewis, played with John Lewis, a ticket seat. So Kid René got me to play with him. Well, I played a few jobs with Chris Kelly. Yeah, I played a few jobs at the Corborator Hall, the Economy Hall. Yeah, I played with them old guys. And I really enjoyed playing with them. I got a lot of experience, you see. And Kid Thomas, he came from over the river once and played back on St. Peter's Street, it was like a lumber yard but they cleaned it up and made a dance…
Can you tell us any more about Chris Kelly, how he sounded? I never got to hear him.
